snippet.title: WheelMates - Announcement Trailer | Two-player Co-op Adventure
snippet.description:
WheelMates is a co-op adventure where two players drive tiny RC cars through the house of an eccentric scientist. Team up to solve puzzles, explore hidden paths, and uncover what happened inside the house.

WheelMates releases in 2026 on PC via Steam, PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S.  For more info:

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3905450/WheelMates/
Join discord: https://discord.com/invite/wheelmates
